name: Pobeg iz frenzzony
source:
The passions run high in the magical school, and the friendsip of certain people is to be tested.

The story is as old as heaven: there’s a boy and a girl, and the boy is deep in a friendzone without any chances. The situation is so hopeless, that even his name is Frienz. And the girl, as usual, doesn’t even suspect anything.

But once he finds a successful time to have his last chance before graduation... Or... does he?..
